intro: These articles are for shops that make their own listing photos and short ads. A template brings a hook, a script, a voice, and a presenter. You add your product, then post the file on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or YouTube Shorts.

Read the piece that matches the job, then open the tool it names. You can paste a [product link](page:url-to-video), pick someone from the [actor library](page:ai-actors), or start from the [template gallery](page:templates). There is no free plan. Downloads have no watermark, and [plans start at $24.50 a month](page:pricing).

faq.q: What is an ad template in these articles?
faq.a: A ready-made ad shape with a hook, a script, a voice, and a presenter. You add your product instead of filming a creator or cutting the ad from a blank file.

faq.q: How does a template become a file?
faq.a: Upload a photo of your product, or paste the product page link. Set the line you want said. The tool returns a creator-style clip you can post.
You can try another hook, another presenter, or another line without waiting on a shoot. A creator can still film a flagship piece. These files are the versions you need for a test.
Shops, marketers, and agencies that sell online. The pieces cover a listing photo, a short ad, a launch clip, a pre-publish check, and a person wearing the item.
Yes. Upload one photo and follow the article into the tool it names. You do not need to edit a timeline before the first file.

faq.q: Which kinds of products do the articles cover?
faq.a: They point at [beauty](page:ind-beauty-skincare), [fashion](page:ind-fashion-clothing), [food and drinks](page:ind-food-drinks), [home](page:ind-home-living), and [electronics](page:ind-electronics). The same tools work for other products you ship.

faq.q: Can I upload my own photo or a product page?
faq.a: Yes. A clear photo of the product you ship is the right start. You can also paste a product page link when the article names that tool.

faq.q: Which platforms can I post to?
faq.a: Post on [TikTok](page:plat-tiktok), [Instagram](page:plat-instagram), [Facebook](page:plat-facebook), [YouTube Shorts](page:plat-youtube-shorts), [Amazon](page:plat-amazon), or [Shopify](page:plat-shopify). Video frames are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. Product photos come out square.
No. Plans start at $24.50 a month for 200 credits. A download has no watermark. You see the credit cost before every job.

faq.q: Can I use the file in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. A finished photo or clip is commercially usable and has no watermark. Do not present a generated person as a customer. The [Content Policy](/content) says what you can upload.
The hook and the shape are already there, so you spend the time on your product and your line. You are not building every ad from nothing.

faq.q: How much does a photo or a clip cost?
faq.a: A product photo is 24 credits. A clip is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Are the people in the clips real customers?
faq.a: No. The person is generated. Do not give them a name or a line that says they bought the product.
